subject: Discovery recap & handoff — clarifying decision criteria
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratex.io>, Stephen Cole <stephen@stratex.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & handoff — clarifying decision criteria

Hi Elena / Stephen —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared picture and a clear next step for the handoff to the technical team:

- Goal: reduce per-query inference cost for ranking models while keeping 50ms p95 latency for production traffic.
- Current constraints: on-prem data residency for PII, existing Redis cache for feature lookups, peak QPS ~900.
- Success criteria you mentioned: latency SLOs (p95), predictable unit cost, and clear audit logs for compliance review.

Open questions we flagged during the call:
1) Which traffic will initially go through Redwood Dedicated vs. a private deployment?
2) Are you able to share a short anonymized request distribution (p95/p50/p99) or a small sample?
3) Who needs to be on the technical scoping call from your side (SRE, security, product)?

Next steps I propose: 30-minute scoping session (engineers + SREs) to align on integration surface and a very early ROI sketch. I attached the discovery notes from today — summarizes the architecture sketch and the list of pre-reqs.

Please let me know if the decision criteria above match what you expect, and who on your side should be invited for the scoping session. If it helps, here are two tentative windows: Wed 11/03 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 11/04 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks —

Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: +1 (415) 555-0192
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachment: discovery-notes-stratex-20271102.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@stratex.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Stephen Cole <stephen@stratex.io>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Following up on decision criteria + quick proposed next steps

Elena —

Circling back since I didn't see a reply on the recap. Short follow-up: do the three decision criteria above still reflect Stratex's priorities? If not, tell me what's shifted and I'll update the notes.

If you're open to the scoping session, here are two new slots (I can flex if needed):
- Tue 11/16 09:30–10:00 PT
- Thu 11/18 13:30–14:00 PT

If it's not the right time, a one-line update on timing is totally fine — e.g., "paused until Q1" or "need to align with procurement" — anything that helps us not chase the wrong horizon.

I can also prepare a short ROI sketch and an integration checklist before the call so your SREs can see concrete numbers. HubSpot record for quick reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/HLX-9876

Thanks again —
